title: Maintain a verified resource list with two AI agents
summary: sit-in runs a Chinese Grok Bot resource list where Grok Bot gathers material daily and Claude Code verifies and reviews it; 84 entries are checked, with a human approving.
agent_role: Grok Bot scouts new links each day; Claude Code checks each repo exists, is active and relevant, and writes the short review. The human only makes the final call.
outcome: The author reports 84 verified entries, 9 reusable recipes and 136 vetted tutorials and articles.
what_they_did: The maintainer set up two agents to keep a list of Grok Bot resources current. Grok Bot searches for new material every day. Claude Code checks each item through GitHub and the web page and writes a short review. The human approves what goes in, and the agents' handoff notes are public.
how_it_went: The author reports 84 checked entries, 9 tested recipes and 136 vetted tutorials and posts, updated over 140 commits.
worth_knowing: Entries carry three trust levels: actually run, docs read, or repo only checked. Only items really tried get the top mark.
prompt: Help me keep a curated list of resources on [topic] up to date. Each day, search for new tools, guides and posts. For each find, check that the link works, it was updated recently, and it truly relates to [topic]. Note its license. Draft a one-line review and a trust level (tested, docs read, or link checked only). Put all drafts in [a file or spreadsheet] and wait for my approval before adding anything to the list.

curation.rationale: Mostly a curated list, but it is openly maintained by two agents (one finds material daily, one verifies and writes reviews) with a human approving, and the collaboration log is public. Thin on results beyond the list itself.
